simple.meaning: מֶחֱזָה (mechĕzâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a window.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מֶחֱזָה (H4237) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Kings 7:4, with occurrences in 1 Kings.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֶחֱזָה (H4237) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מֶחֱזָה (H4237) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מֶחֱזָה (mechĕzâh) / H4237 is traced through 1 Kings 7:4, 1 Kings 7:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
